title: File:SpaceX Starship Superheavy Testing February 2023 (cropped).jpg
desc: SpaceX Starship's Superheavy Booster, serial no. B7, being tested on the orbital launch pad at Starbase, Boca Chica, Texas in February 2023.

title: File:SpaceX Starbase launch facility (51438071556).jpg
desc: View from across the bay. From left to right: Starship booster, Starship SN20, cryogenic tank bank, "Mechzilla" launch tower.

title: File:SpaceX Starbase integration tower quick disconnect arm.jpg
desc: The quick disconnect arm that fuels the SpaceX Starship, two days after the latter’s first orbital launch attemptCreator: Jenny Hautmann for Supercluster

title: File:Starship full stack with Jeep.jpg
desc: SpaceX's Starship (Starship SN20 and Super Heavy BN4) fully stacked at SpaceX Starbase in Boca Chica, Texas with a Jeep in the foreground for scale.

title: File:Starship & Moonset.jpg
desc:
The moon sets behind the most powerful rocket ever constructed that will one day take humanity back to the moon and on to Mars.
Specifically, this is SpaceX's Starship SN20 sitting on top of Super Heavy BN4.

title: File:Starship full stack.jpg

desc: The ground support tanks are at the middle, and the launch tower under construction is on the right, surrounded by cranes. Cropped from original.
